notes: 1 @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ If Playing Safe, Queue 2-3 If Opponent Can Be Harrassed
Pasamos 1 de @resource/resource_food.webp@ a construir el Hippo, 1 de @resource/resource_gold.webp@ a madera y Rally @resource/rally.webp@ a madera.

Al terminar el Bastion Varego@building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ manda los aldeanos@unit_worker/villager.webp@ ayudar Subir de Edad@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@@age/age_2.webp@. Empieza hacer muros@building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ de Madera tambien. Quitas el aldeano@unit_worker/villager.webp@ de donde este mas cerca de hacer el muro.
Hasta subir de edad fue mandando los nuevos aldeanos@unit_worker/villager.webp@ a oro paso de 2 a 5. Aqui tiene 3-4 Lanzas@unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@
Herreria @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ y hacer @technology_macedonian/scale-barding-2.webp@ y @technology_macedonian/blade-inlaying-2.webp@ cuando puedas.

notes: 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ make 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ on the side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ near the @resource/berrybush.webp@
Rally 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@, then back to @resource/sheep.webp@
Put all @resource/sheep.webp@ on side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ nearest to the @resource/berrybush.webp@
[Make sure its eco bonus radius extends to the 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@]
[If against Knight or Horse Civ, build @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ into @unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@ and @unit_macedonian/bogmadr-2.webp@]

When 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, Rally @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 11 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
[Now you can either go into Feudal Rush to Age-Up to Castle Age]

Send 5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 10 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@

6 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ in a forward position near @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ (if possible)
Upgrade your units and start making @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@

notes: Next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ [When Villager 75% Completion Move 1@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ and build @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ [try to build it close to TC)
Rally to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and move @unit_worker/villager.webp@ who built @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Move 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@from@resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ | Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ and keep @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Produce @unit_macedonian/hippodrome_horseman.webp@ and move 5 @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ | Use 1 to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and 1 to build @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ | Use 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build @building_economy/house.webp@ (Keep @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@)
@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ as soon as you can and harass with @unit_macedonian/hippodrome_horseman.webp@ and @unit_macedonian/hippodrome_scout.webp@

Build @building_economy/market.webp@ with @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and use excess @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for production buildings | Move 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (Keep producing @unit_macedonian/hippodrome_horseman.webp@ and keep @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 10 then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@)

Produce units based on what you are against and use @building_economy/market.webp@ to buy more @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build another @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ to keep producing units faster | Research @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@

Go @age/age_2.webp@  with 4@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@)| Send 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 6

As soon as 2nd @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ is queued, send 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from@resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@  then @resource/resource_food.webp@
when 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 3@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from wood to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and  3@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Once @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ done, get @technology_macedonian/scale-barding-2.webp@ ASAP | Keep @resource/rally.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@

When close to enough @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @age/age_3.webp@ (around 450@resource/resource_gold.webp@), move 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Age up to @age/age_3.webp@ ASAP, send 8)@unit_worker/villager.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ around ressources like @resource/resource_gold.webp@, @resource/deer.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@

Get the military upgrades and the eco upgrades ASAP@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@
Start to produce @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@ with @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ | Set @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ on @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@
Build @building_religious/monastery.webp@ ASAP and go get @resource/relics.webp@ (protect @resource/relics.webp@ with @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@ if needed)
Later on you can add @building_military/stable.webp@@building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ to produce more @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@
